info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Hotel Loyalty Points Tiers-v2-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Tiers API enables developers to access and retrieve data regarding various loyalty points tiers associated with the hotel's rewards program. This endpoint provides information about the different levels of membership, their benefits, and the points required to achieve each tier. Typically used by hotel management systems and customer service platforms, this API helps enhance user experiences by providing transparent details to customers about their loyalty status and potential rewards. By integrating this API, businesses can streamline customer engagement and promote loyalty initiatives effectively.

get.summary: Retrieve the current tier details for points.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current tier details associated with your points. It provides information necessary to understand the benefits or rewards based on your current tier status.
